/-!
# Dimension bounds for analytic subsets

Blueprint `rem:dimension`, `rem:isolated-dim-zero` (Demailly, *Complex analytic and differential
geometry*, II.5; used throughout II.8).  For a subset `A` of a complex manifold:

* `DimLE A p`: every regular point of `A` has dimension `≤ p` (`dim A ≤ p`);
* `LocDimGE A x q`: every neighbourhood of `x` contains a regular point of `A` of dimension `≥ q`
  (`dim_x A ≥ q`);
* `LocDimLE A x p`: on some neighbourhood of `x`, every regular point of `A` has dimension `≤ p`
  (`dim_x A ≤ p`);
* `IsPureDim A k`: every regular point has dimension `k`; `ProperOn F A`: `A ∩ F⁻¹(K)` is compact
  for every compact `K`.

Basic facts: the two local bounds are compatible (`LocDimGE.le_of_locDimLE`); a regular point of
dimension `k` has local dimension exactly `k` (`locDimGE_of_regularAtDim`,
`locDimLE_of_regularAtDim`); every point of an analytic set has local dimension `≥ 0`
(`locDimGE_zero`, density of the regular locus); and a point of local dimension `≤ 0` is isolated
(`not_accPt_of_locDimLE_zero`): otherwise it lies on a positive-dimensional irreducible component,
which fills `A` near one of its top-dimensional regular points.
-/

/-- The restriction of `F` to `A` is proper: `A ∩ F⁻¹(K)` is compact for every compact `K`. -/
def ProperOn {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (F : X → Y) (A : Set X) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ K : Set Y, IsCompact K → IsCompact (A ∩ F ⁻¹' K)

/-- `dim_x A ≤ p`: on some neighbourhood of `x`, every regular point of `A` has dimension at most
`p`. -/
def LocDimLE (A : Set M) (x : M) (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ k, RegularAtDim (n := n) A y k → k ≤ p

omit [IsComplexManifold n M] in
theorem LocDimGE.le_of_locDimLE {A : Set M} {x : M} {q p : ℕ} (hq : LocDimGE (n := n) A x q)
    (hp : LocDimLE (n := n) A x p) : q ≤ p := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUp⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨y, hyU, k, hqk, hy⟩ := hq U hU
  exact hqk.trans (hUp y hyU k hy)

omit [IsComplexManifold n M] in
theorem DimLE.locDimLE {A : Set M} {p : ℕ} (h : DimLE (n := n) A p) (x : M) :
    LocDimLE (n := n) A x p :=
  ⟨univ, univ_mem, fun y _ k hy => h y k hy⟩

/-- A regular point of dimension `k` has local dimension `≤ k`. -/
theorem locDimLE_of_regularAtDim {A : Set M} {x : M} {k : ℕ} (hx : RegularAtDim (n := n) A x k) :
    LocDimLE (n := n) A x k := by
  refine ⟨_, RegularPatchNeighborhood.eventually_regularAtDim hx, fun y hy j hyj => ?_⟩
  exact (RegularPointDimension.eq_of_regularAtDim hyj (hy hyj.2.1)).le

/-- Every point of an analytic set has local dimension `≥ 0`. -/
theorem locDimGE_zero {A : Set M} (hA : IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) A) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ A) :
    LocDimGE (n := n) A x 0 := by
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨y, hyU, k, hy⟩ := RegularLocusDense.exists_regularAtDim_mem_nhds hA hx hU
  exact ⟨y, hyU, k, Nat.zero_le k, hy⟩

/-- **Points of local dimension zero are isolated** (`rem:isolated-dim-zero`). -/
theorem not_accPt_of_locDimLE_zero {A : Set M} (hA : IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) A) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ A) (h0 : LocDimLE (n := n) A x 0) : ¬ AccPt x (𝓟 A) := by
  intro hacc
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hU0⟩ := h0
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hpos, hxV⟩ :=
    PositiveDimensionalComponent.exists_isIrreducibleComponent_pos_dim_of_accPt hA hx hacc
  obtain ⟨y, hyreg, W, hW, hyW, hWU, hAW⟩ :=
    IrreducibleComponentFilling.exists_mem_regularLocus_isOpen_inter_subset hA hV isOpen_interior
      ⟨x, hxV, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hU⟩
  have hAW' : V.carrier ∩ W = A ∩ W :=
    Subset.antisymm (fun z hz => ⟨hV.1 hz.1, hz.2⟩) (fun z hz => ⟨hAW hz, hz.2⟩)
  have hyA : RegularAtDim (n := n) A y V.dim :=
    RegularPointDimension.regularAtDim_of_inter_eq hW hyW hAW' hyreg
  have := hU0 y (interior_subset (hWU hyW)) V.dim hyA
  omega

variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M]
  [IsComplexManifold n M]

variable {U : Opens M}
original_declaration_blocks:
theorem chartAt_opens_apply (x y : U) :
    chartAt (ComplexModel n) x y = chartAt (ComplexModel n) (x : M) y := rfl

theorem chart_mem_opens_target {x y : U}
    (hy : (y : M) ∈ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) (x : M)).source) :
    chartAt (ComplexModel n) (x : M) y ∈ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).target :=
  (chartAt (ComplexModel n) (x : M)).map_subtype_source ⟨x⟩ hy

/-- The trace on `U` of a presentation of `A` at a point of `U`. -/
def presentationPreimageVal {A : Set M} (x : U)
    (P : ComplexAnalyticPresentationAt (n := n) A (x : M)) :
    ComplexAnalyticPresentationAt (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) x where
  generatorCount := P.generatorCount
  generator := P.generator
  coordinateNeighborhood := P.coordinateNeighborhood ∩ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).target
  isOpen_coordinateNeighborhood :=
    P.isOpen_coordinateNeighborhood.inter (isOpen_chartAt_opens_target x)
  center_mem_coordinateNeighborhood :=
    ⟨P.center_mem_coordinateNeighborhood, (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).map_source
      (mem_chart_source (ComplexModel n) x)⟩
  coordinateNeighborhood_subset_target := inter_subset_right
  generator_holomorphic i := (P.generator_holomorphic i).mono inter_subset_left
  zeroLocus := by
    intro y hy hyN
    exact P.zeroLocus (y := (y : M)) (mem_chartAt_opens_source.mp hy) hyN.1

/-- **Restriction**: `A ∩ U` is analytic in `U` when `A` is analytic in `M`. -/
theorem isComplexAnalyticSubset_preimage_val {A : Set M}
    (hA : IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) A) (U : Opens M) :
    IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) :=
  fun x => ⟨presentationPreimageVal x (hA x).some⟩

/-- A presentation of `A ∩ U` in `U` at `x` is a presentation of `A` in `M` at `x`. -/
def presentationOfPreimageVal {A : Set M} (x : U)
    (P : ComplexAnalyticPresentationAt (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) x) :
    ComplexAnalyticPresentationAt (n := n) A (x : M) where
  generatorCount := P.generatorCount
  generator := P.generator
  coordinateNeighborhood := P.coordinateNeighborhood
  isOpen_coordinateNeighborhood := P.isOpen_coordinateNeighborhood
  center_mem_coordinateNeighborhood := P.center_mem_coordinateNeighborhood
  coordinateNeighborhood_subset_target :=
    P.coordinateNeighborhood_subset_target.trans (chartAt_opens_target_subset x)
  generator_holomorphic := P.generator_holomorphic
  zeroLocus := by
    intro y hy hyN
    have hyU : y ∈ U := mem_opens_of_chart_mem_target hy (P.coordinateNeighborhood_subset_target hyN)
    exact P.zeroLocus (y := ⟨y, hyU⟩) (mem_chartAt_opens_source.mpr hy) hyN

/-- **Analyticity is local**: if every point has an open neighbourhood `U` with `A ∩ U` analytic
in `U`, then `A` is analytic. -/
theorem isComplexAnalyticSubset_of_forall_opens {A : Set M}
    (h : ∀ x : M, ∃ U : Opens M, x ∈ U ∧
      IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U)) :
    IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) A := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU⟩ := h x
  exact ⟨presentationOfPreimageVal (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U) (hU ⟨x, hxU⟩).some⟩

theorem isComplexAnalyticSubset_iff_forall_opens {A : Set M} :
    IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) A ↔ ∀ x : M, ∃ U : Opens M, x ∈ U ∧
      IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) :=
  ⟨fun hA _ => ⟨⊤, trivial, isComplexAnalyticSubset_preimage_val hA ⊤⟩,
    isComplexAnalyticSubset_of_forall_opens⟩

/-- A subset of `U` which is analytic in `U` and closed in `M` is analytic in `M`. -/
theorem isComplexAnalyticSubset_image_val {B : Set U}
    (hB : IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) B) (hc : IsClosed ((↑) '' B : Set M)) :
    IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) ((↑) '' B : Set M) := by
  refine isComplexAnalyticSubset_of_forall_opens fun x => ?_
  by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
  · refine ⟨U, hxU, ?_⟩
    rwa [Subtype.val_injective.preimage_image]
  · refine ⟨⟨_, hc.isOpen_compl⟩, fun hx => hxU ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact y.2
    · have : ((↑) ⁻¹' ((↑) '' B : Set M) : Set (⟨_, hc.isOpen_compl⟩ : Opens M)) = ∅ := by
        ext y
        simp only [mem_preimage, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        exact y.2
      rw [this]
      exact fun y => ⟨ComplexAnalyticPresentationAt.empty y⟩

theorem regularAtDim_image_val_iff {B : Set U} {x : U} {k : ℕ} :
    RegularAtDim (n := n) ((↑) '' B : Set M) (x : M) k ↔ RegularAtDim (n := n) B x k := by
  rw [← regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff, Subtype.val_injective.preimage_image]

theorem mem_opens_of_regularAtDim_image_val {B : Set U} {y : M} {k : ℕ}
    (hy : RegularAtDim (n := n) ((↑) '' B : Set M) y k) : y ∈ U := by
  obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := hy.2.1
  exact z.2

theorem dimLE_preimage_val {A : Set M} {p : ℕ} (h : DimLE (n := n) A p) (U : Opens M) :
    DimLE (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) p :=
  fun y k hy => h y k (regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff.mp hy)

theorem dimLE_image_val_iff {B : Set U} {p : ℕ} :
    DimLE (n := n) ((↑) '' B : Set M) p ↔ DimLE (n := n) B p := by
  constructor
  · intro h y k hy
    exact h y k (regularAtDim_image_val_iff.mpr hy)
  · intro h y k hy
    have hyU := mem_opens_of_regularAtDim_image_val hy
    exact h ⟨y, hyU⟩ k (regularAtDim_image_val_iff.mp hy)

theorem isPureDim_image_val_iff {B : Set U} {k : ℕ} :
    IsPureDim (n := n) ((↑) '' B : Set M) k ↔ IsPureDim (n := n) B k := by
  constructor
  · intro h y j hy
    exact h y j (regularAtDim_image_val_iff.mpr hy)
  · intro h y j hy
    have hyU := mem_opens_of_regularAtDim_image_val hy
    exact h ⟨y, hyU⟩ j (regularAtDim_image_val_iff.mp hy)

theorem nhds_opens_eq_comap (x : U) : 𝓝 x = comap ((↑) : U → M) (𝓝 (x : M)) :=
  nhds_induced _ _

theorem locDimGE_preimage_val_iff {A : Set M} {x : U} {q : ℕ} :
    LocDimGE (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) x q ↔ LocDimGE (n := n) A (x : M) q := by
  constructor
  · intro h W hW
    have hV : ((↑) ⁻¹' W : Set U) ∈ 𝓝 x := by
      rw [nhds_opens_eq_comap]; exact preimage_mem_comap hW
    obtain ⟨y, hyV, k, hqk, hy⟩ := h _ hV
    exact ⟨y, hyV, k, hqk, regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff.mp hy⟩
  · intro h V hV
    rw [nhds_opens_eq_comap, mem_comap] at hV
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hWV⟩ := hV
    obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyW, hyU⟩, k, hqk, hy⟩ :=
      h (W ∩ U) (inter_mem hW (U.isOpen.mem_nhds x.2))
    exact ⟨⟨y, hyU⟩, hWV hyW, k, hqk, regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff.mpr hy⟩

theorem locDimLE_preimage_val_iff {A : Set M} {x : U} {p : ℕ} :
    LocDimLE (n := n) ((↑) ⁻¹' A : Set U) x p ↔ LocDimLE (n := n) A (x : M) p := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨V, hV, hVp⟩
    rw [nhds_opens_eq_comap, mem_comap] at hV
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hWV⟩ := hV
    refine ⟨W ∩ U, inter_mem hW (U.isOpen.mem_nhds x.2), fun y hy k hyk => ?_⟩
    exact hVp ⟨y, hy.2⟩ (hWV hy.1) k (regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff.mpr hyk)
  · rintro ⟨W, hW, hWp⟩
    refine ⟨((↑) : U → M) ⁻¹' W, ?_, fun y hy k hyk =>
      hWp y hy k (regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff.mp hyk)⟩
    rw [nhds_opens_eq_comap]; exact preimage_mem_comap hW

def planeSubmodule (N r : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (ComplexModel N) where

  add_mem' := by
    intro a b ha hb i hi
    simp [ha i hi, hb i hi]

variable {N : ℕ} {R : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup R] [NormedSpace ℂ R] [FiniteDimensional ℂ R]

/-- A linear map which has a holomorphic right inverse on a nonempty open set is onto. -/
theorem range_eq_top_of_rightInverse (Q : ComplexModel N →L[ℂ] R) {B' : Set R} (hB' : IsOpen B')
    (hne : B'.Nonempty) {k : R → ComplexModel N} (hQk : ∀ w ∈ B', Q (k w) = w) :
    LinearMap.range (Q : ComplexModel N →ₗ[ℂ] R) = ⊤ := by
  apply Submodule.eq_top_of_nonempty_interior'

    fun w hw => ⟨k w, hQk w hw⟩

/-- **A graph over a linear projection is a submanifold.**  If `Q ∘ k = id` on the open set

theorem regularAtDim_graph (Q : ComplexModel N →L[ℂ] R) {B' : Set R} (hB' : IsOpen B')

    {y : ComplexModel N} (hy : Q y ∈ B') (hky : k (Q y) = y) :

  have htop := range_eq_top_of_rightInverse Q hB' ⟨_, hy⟩ hQk
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℂ R + Module.finrank ℂ K = N := by
    have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Q : ComplexModel N →ₗ[ℂ] R)
    rw [htop, finrank_top, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at this
    exact this

  let P : ComplexModel N →L[ℂ] K :=
    (Submodule.projectionOnto K K' hK').toContinuousLinearMap
  have hP : ∀ u : K, P u = u := fun u => Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left hK' u
  let Wsub : Submodule ℂ (R × K) := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.snd ℂ R K)
  have hWdim : Module.finrank ℂ Wsub = Module.finrank ℂ R := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (LinearMap.inl_injective (R := ℂ) (M := R) (M₂ := K))
    rw [LinearMap.range_inl] at h
    exact h

    rw [Module.finrank_prod, hdim]

    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : (Q v, P (v - k' (Q v))) = 0 := by

    rw [hΦΘ]
    simp only [Θ, sub_self, hky]
    simp
  · intro z _ hz
    change z ∈ {z | Q z ∈ B' ∧ k (Q z) = z} ↔ Φ.toFun z ∈ complexCoordinatePlane N _
    have hzN : Q z ∈ B' := hΦN hz

    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      ext1
      simp [h]
    · intro h
      refine ⟨hzN, ?_⟩
      have := congrArg Subtype.val h

      exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]

/-- **Constant-rank images are submanifolds** (blueprint `rem:constant-rank-submanifold`).  If
`G` is holomorphic of constant rank `r` on the open set `U ∋ p`, then some open neighbourhood `O`
of `p` in `U` is mapped onto the zero set, in an open set `W`, of a holomorphic map `h`, and every
point of `G(O)` is a regular point of `G(O)` of dimension `r`. -/
theorem exists_image_eq_graph {G : E → ComplexModel N} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : DifferentiableOn ℂ G U) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ z ∈ U, Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℂ G z : E →L[ℂ] ComplexModel N) :
      E →ₗ[ℂ] ComplexModel N)) = r)
    {p : E} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    ∃ (O : Set E) (W : Set (ComplexModel N)) (h : ComplexModel N → ComplexModel N),
      IsOpen O ∧ p ∈ O ∧ O ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen W ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ h W ∧
      G '' O = {y | y ∈ W ∧ h y = 0} ∧
      ∀ y ∈ G '' O, RegularAtDim (n := N) (M := ComplexModel N) (G '' O) y r := by
  obtain ⟨Q, S, ψ, k, ρ, hρ, hopen, hψp, hψ, -, hkd, hQk, hnf⟩ := exists_normalForm hU hG hr hp
  have himg := image_eq_graph (G := G) (ψ := ψ) (k := k) (Q := Q) (c := (Q (G p), S p))
    (ρ := ρ) hQk hnf
  refine ⟨ψ '' ball (Q (G p), S p) ρ, Q ⁻¹' ball (Q (G p)) ρ, fun y => y - k (Q y), hopen,
    ⟨_, mem_ball_self hρ, hψp⟩, ?_, isOpen_ball.preimage Q.continuous, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact (hψ w hw).1
  · exact differentiableOn_id.sub (hkd.comp Q.differentiableOn fun y hy => hy)
  · rw [himg]
    ext y
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_preimage, sub_eq_zero]
    exact and_congr_right fun _ => eq_comm
  · intro y hy
    rw [himg] at hy ⊢
    have := regularAtDim_graph Q isOpen_ball hkd hQk hy.1 hy.2
    rwa [hr p hp] at this

    ∃ U : Set M, IsOpen U ∧ p ∈ U ∧ A ∩ U ⊆ B := by

      (e y - e p ∈ chartGerm (n := n) A p → e y - e p ∈ chartGerm (n := n) B p) :=

`bcalc:nonmonomial-order-local` (chapter `blowup-calculus.tex`).  Sources: Włodarczyk 2005 (`wlodarczyk05-hironaka`),

# Splitting a tower, along restriction to open sets and along isomorphisms of towers

Blueprint `hir:tower-split-iso` (`blueprint/src/hironaka.tex`, Hironaka phase H4).  In the maximal-order case and the
general step (`hir:maximal-order-step`, `hir:general-step`) the lower-dimensional invariant at a point is computed along the
tail of the split of the segment at a stage depending on the point (`BlowupTowerSplit.split`).  Properties (5) and (6) of
`hir:centre-function` for the new invariant compare the split of a restricted tower `T|_U`, resp. of an isomorphic tower
`T'`, with the split of `T`; this module gives the comparison as isomorphisms of towers (TN23's `IsTowerIso`), so that
properties (5) and (6) of the inductive invariant apply to the pieces.  Source: Włodarczyk 2005 (arXiv `hiron.tex`), the
commutativity of the resolution procedure of Step 1 with étale morphisms (the induced sequence `φ^*(X_i)_{i_l ≤ i ≤ i_{l+1}}`
of each part of the resolution).

The restriction `restrict U T` of a tower is not definitionally the concatenation of the restricted pieces (the stages agree
only propositionally), so the comparisons are isomorphisms of towers whose last-stage maps are the identity on points.

## Main results

* `IsTowerIso.congr_last`, `IsTowerIso.congr_base`: an isomorphism of towers may be stated with any pointwise equal
  last-stage map, resp. base biholomorphism;
* `isTowerIso_restrict_of_append_eq`: the form `T₀.append T₁ = T` of TN23's `isTowerIso_restrict_append`;
  `openPreimage_head_tail`, `isTowerIso_restrict_head_tail`: the restriction of `T` is isomorphic to the concatenation of
  the restrictions of the head and of the tail of its split;
* `exists_isTowerIso_split_restrict`: **the split of a restricted tower is the restriction of the split** -- the head of
  `split (restrict U T) j` is isomorphic over `id_U` to `restrict U (head T j)`, and its tail, over that isomorphism, to
  `restrict (openPreimage (head T j) U) (tail T j)` with last-stage map the identity on points; `proj_tail_split_restrict`:
  the head isomorphism sends the image of a point in the head stage of the restricted split to its image in the head stage
  of the split;
* `IsTowerIso.exists_split`: **splits correspond along isomorphisms of towers** -- for `IsTowerIso Φ T' T χ` the heads of the
  splits at `j` are isomorphic over `Φ` and the tails over that isomorphism, with last-stage map `χ`.

Import discipline (Hironaka phase): this module does not import, even transitively,
`Pending.RelativePrincipalization` or `Pending.EmbeddedResolution`.  Sorry-free.
-/

/-- A preconnected set of `0`-dimensional regular points is a subsingleton. -/
theorem subset_singleton_of_isPreconnected {A G : Set M} (hGA : G ⊆ A)
    (hG : IsPreconnected G) (hreg : ∀ y ∈ G, RegularAtDim (n := n) A y 0) {g : M}
    (hg : g ∈ G) : G ⊆ {g} := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hgO, hAO⟩ :=
    exists_isOpen_inter_subset_singleton_of_regularAtDim_zero (hreg g hg)
  have hcover : G ⊆ O ∪ {g}ᶜ := by
    intro z _
    by_cases hzg : z = g
    · exact Or.inl (hzg ▸ hgO)
    · exact Or.inr hzg
  have hdisj : G ∩ (O ∩ {g}ᶜ) = ∅ := by
    refine eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr ?_
    rintro z ⟨hzG, hzO, hzg⟩
    exact hzg (hAO ⟨hGA hzG, hzO⟩)
  have hGO : G ⊆ O := by
    rcases isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hG O {g}ᶜ hO isOpen_compl_singleton
      hcover hdisj with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (h hg) (by simp)
  exact fun z hz => hAO ⟨hGA hz, hGO hz⟩

/-- **Positive-dimensional components through non-isolated points.** A point of an
analytic subset `A` which is not isolated in `A` lies on a positive-dimensional
irreducible component of `A`. -/
theorem exists_isIrreducibleComponent_pos_dim_of_accPt {A : Set M}
    (hA : IsComplexAnalyticSubset (n := n) A) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hacc : AccPt x (𝓟 A)) :
    ∃ V : ClosedIrreducibleAnalyticSubvariety n M,
      IsIrreducibleComponent V A ∧ 0 < V.dim ∧ x ∈ V.carrier := by
  obtain ⟨D, ⟨P⟩⟩ := exists_connectedParts hA hx
  have hpieceA : ∀ i, D.piece i ⊆ A := fun i y hy =>
    (D.inter_nbhd_eq.symm ▸ mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hy⟩ : y ∈ A ∩ D.nbhd).1
  have hgoodA : ∀ i, P.good i ⊆ A := fun i =>
    (P.good_subset i).trans (inter_subset_left.trans (hpieceA i))
  -- some piece is positive-dimensional
  have hpos : ∃ i, 0 < D.dim i := by
    by_contra hcon
    simp only [not_exists, not_lt] at hcon
    have hsing : ∀ i, D.piece i ∩ P.core i ⊆ {x} := by
      intro i
      have hmem : x ∈ closure (P.good i) :=
        P.subset_closure_good i ⟨P.mem_piece i, P.mem_core i⟩
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.mp hmem univ univ_mem
      have hGg : P.good i ⊆ {g} := subset_singleton_of_isPreconnected (hgoodA i)
        (P.isPreconnected_good i)
        (fun y hy => Nat.le_zero.mp (hcon i) ▸ P.regularAtDim_of_mem_good i y hy) hg.2
      have hcl : closure (P.good i) ⊆ {g} := by
        simpa using closure_mono hGg

# The constant rank theorem for holomorphic maps

Blueprint `rem:constant-rank` (used without proof in Demailly, *Complex analytic and differential
geometry*, II.8.1 and II.8.5).  Let `G : E → F` be holomorphic on an open set `U` of a
finite-dimensional complex normed space, with `rank dG_z = r` for every `z ∈ U`, and `p ∈ U`.
Write `L = dG_p`, `R = range L` (dimension `r`) and `K = ker L`.

* `exists_normalForm`: there are continuous linear projections `Q : F → R` and `S : E → K`, a
  ball `B` around `Ψ p` in `R × K`, where `Ψ z = (Q (G z), S z)`, a holomorphic inverse `ψ : B → U`
  of `Ψ` (`Ψ (ψ w) = w`, `ψ (Ψ p) = p`, `ψ '' B` open), and a holomorphic `k` on the first factor
  of `B` with `Q ∘ k = id` and the normal form
  `G (ψ w) = k w.1`  for `w ∈ B`:
  in the chart `ψ`, `G` depends only on the first `r` coordinates and is the graph map `k` there.
* `exists_ne_mem_fibre`: if `r < dim E`, then `p` is an accumulation point of its fibre
  `G⁻¹(G p)`.
* `image_eq_graph`: in the normal form, `G (ψ (ball c ρ))` is the graph
  `{y | Q y ∈ ball c.1 ρ ∧ k (Q y) = y}`, the zero set of `y ↦ y - k (Q y)` in `Q⁻¹(ball c.1 ρ)`.

## Proof

`Ψ = (Q ∘ G, S)` has derivative `(Q ∘ L, S)` at `p`, which is injective (a vector killed by both
lies in `K` and is fixed by `S`), hence bijective by rank--nullity, so the inverse function theorem
gives `ψ`.  On `B`, `H = G ∘ ψ` satisfies `Q ∘ dH = fst` (first component of `dΨ`), and
`rank dH = rank dG = r = dim R`; so `Q` is injective on `range dH`, and `dH (0, v) = 0` because
`Q (dH (0, v)) = 0`.  Hence `H` is constant along the convex slices `{w'} × ball`, which is the
normal form with `k w' = H (w', c)`.
-/

theorem exists_isOpen_subset_inter_subset_of_mem {A : Set M}

    (hV : IsIrreducibleComponent V A) {p : M} (hp : p ∈ V.carrier) {O : Set M}

    ∃ U : Set M, IsOpen U ∧ U ⊆ O ∧ (V.carrier ∩ U).Nonempty ∧ A ∩ U ⊆ V.carrier := by
  classical
  have hpA : p ∈ A := hV.1 hp
  obtain ⟨D, ⟨P⟩⟩ := exists_connectedParts hA hpA
  -- a regular point of every connected part, inside `O`
  have hc : ∀ i, ∃ c, c ∈ O ∧ c ∈ P.good i := fun i =>
    mem_closure_iff.mp (P.subset_closure_good i ⟨P.mem_piece i, P.mem_core i⟩) O hO hpO
  choose c hcO hcG using hc
  have hcreg : ∀ i, RegularAtDim (n := n) A (c i) (D.dim i) := fun i =>
    P.regularAtDim_of_mem_good i (c i) (hcG i)
  let C : Fin D.count → ClosedIrreducibleAnalyticSubvariety n M := fun i =>
    componentSubvariety hA (hcreg i)
  have hgoodC : ∀ i, P.good i ⊆ component (n := n) A (c i) := fun i =>
    (P.isPreconnected_good i).subset_connectedComponentIn (hcG i)
      (fun y hy => ⟨D.dim i, P.regularAtDim_of_mem_good i y hy⟩)
  have hpieceC : ∀ i, D.piece i ∩ P.core i ⊆ (C i).carrier := fun i =>
    (P.subset_closure_good i).trans (closure_mono (hgoodC i))
  -- near `p`, `A` lies in the union of the `C i`
  have hΩo : IsOpen (D.nbhd ∩ ⋂ i, P.core i) :=
    D.isOpen_nbhd.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite P.isOpen_core)
  have hpΩ : p ∈ D.nbhd ∩ ⋂ i, P.core i := ⟨D.mem_nbhd, mem_iInter.mpr P.mem_core⟩
  have hAΩ : A ∩ (D.nbhd ∩ ⋂ i, P.core i) ⊆ ⋃ i, (C i).carrier := by
    rintro y ⟨hyA, hyN, hyc⟩
    have hy : y ∈ A ∩ D.nbhd := ⟨hyA, hyN⟩
    rw [D.inter_nbhd_eq] at hy
    obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hpieceC i ⟨hyi, mem_iInter.mp hyc i⟩⟩
  -- the pieces are indexed by a nonempty finite type; re-index them by `ℕ`
  have hcount : 0 < D.count := by
    have hp' : p ∈ A ∩ D.nbhd := ⟨hpA, D.mem_nbhd⟩
    rw [D.inter_nbhd_eq] at hp'
    obtain ⟨i, -⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hp'
    exact Fin.pos i
  let idx : ℕ → Fin D.count := fun m =>
    if h : m < D.count then ⟨m, h⟩ else ⟨0, hcount⟩
  have hidx : ∀ i : Fin D.count, idx i.val = i := fun i => by
    simp [idx, i.isLt]
  have hcover : V.carrier ∩ (D.nbhd ∩ ⋂ i, P.core i) ⊆ ⋃ m, (C (idx m)).carrier := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (hAΩ ⟨hV.1 hy.1, hy.2⟩)
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i.val, ?_⟩
    rw [hidx i]

    (fun m => (C (idx m)).analytic) hΩo ⟨p, hp, hpΩ⟩ hcover

    hV.2 (C (idx m)) hVm (componentSubvariety_subset hA (hcreg (idx m)))

    exists_open_inter_subset_component (hcreg (idx m)) (mem_component_self (hcreg (idx m)))
  refine ⟨W ∩ O, hW.inter hO, inter_subset_right, ⟨c (idx m), ?_, hcW, hcO (idx m)⟩, ?_⟩
